findings.title: Unknown ends cannot be represented without indefinite presence
findings.finding: Null end means indefinite existence; historical search also excludes null-ended records. A status-only fix would leave navigation, timeline and panel misleading.
findings.recommendation: Add distinct legal/operational ending claims and evidence of presence; use a shared resolver in builder, snapshots, search, navigation and panels. Import seven proved board identities without claiming current existence or proved extinction.

findings.title: Subsidiary relation becomes accountability path
findings.finding: Powertech parents have relation subsidiary_of; snapshot emits part, which pathToPeople traverses. Direct 2026 probe returns a complete uninferred path through BC Hydro.
findings.recommendation: Preserve subsidiary_of/owned_by and exclude it from accountability traversal. Require a distinct sourced responsibility edge. Use separate board-appointment type from the traversable appoints edge.

findings.title: Local-register description overstates uniform non-operation and elected trustees
findings.finding: The blanket statement that neither district type runs a hospital is too strong. Original Fort Nelson and 100 Mile House instruments assign hospital board-of-management roles to the district trustees plus a Hospital Act appointee. Fort Nelson's first trustees were appointed, with later elections.
findings.recommendation: State body-specific functions and dated governance. Financial-assistance objects alone do not prove hospital operation; hospital-management clauses must not be erased. Do not infer the legal hospital operator solely from shared trustees.

findings.title: A register excluded from all diagram consumption does not complete local history
findings.finding: Separate local identities are correct, but the proposal explicitly makes the register unread by the diagram build. No-ministry status is not no local democratic accountability.
findings.recommendation: Read local records into shared identity/search/event/panel resolvers. Add optional local/regional layer with own governance and electorate profiles; do not force ministerial parenting. Replace no-ministry-only explanation for local records.

findings.title: Recommendation-only minister role discards precise statutory relationships
findings.finding: The proposal forbids minister roles beyond recommendation despite held evidence for capital approval and inspection powers.
findings.recommendation: Keep approvals, inspection and appointments as typed, dated relationships without converting them to responsibility. Preserve the 2026 current-law checkpoint as an observation rather than backdating it.

evidence.locator: Hospital District Act ss.8,17,32,45; current-law checkpoint on 2026-10-21
OIC1549/1995 Schedule A; powers restricted from 1995-12-31

findings.title: Date precision and end-event meaning are collapsed
findings.finding: Year-only 1997 becomes January 1 internally and sub-agency ends become dissolved events regardless of their meaning. 43 council execution days remain untraced.
findings.recommendation: Preserve date precision and eventKind. Treat any rendering cutoff separately from a factual legal end. Do not turn conditional amalgamation authority into proof of execution.

counts.other_two: Simon Fraser Health Board and Burnaby Health Board

findings.title: Related event subjects are dropped
findings.finding: atlas:round4-gvrhd-dissolved-1999 carries recipient related_subject_ids, but the event builder omits that field. District events use ministry subjects because the actual local corporations have no register consumer.
findings.recommendation: Preserve primary and related subject IDs and explicit roles; index events to real transferors and recipients, independent of whether their nodes are currently drawn.

findings.title: Single ended field mixes operational cessation and legal dissolution
findings.finding: New endedMeaning improves wording only. MTOC stops on operational transfer, while health societies remain until legal registry dissolution after service transfer.
findings.recommendation: Represent both ends. Let the selected operating/legal view define visibility and clearly mark continuing legal shells. Do not drop legal history or imply delivery continued until dissolution.

good_decisions: Do not convert the seven rural boards into the 1997 societies without a source connecting legal identities.
Do not use repeal of board-composition regulations as corporate dissolution.
Keep regional hospital districts distinct from health boards and same-named corporations incorporated at different dates.
Preserve approval versus commencement, restricted powers versus dissolution, deadline versus actual transfer, and multiple asset recipients.
Keep current-law observations from being backdated into historical governance.
Retain servicesPassedTo separately from legal becameId.
Keep FNHA partnership outside the ministry accountability route.
Keep People central and distinguish eligible electors from all people served.

schema_recommendation.strategy: Additive lifecycle block; retain current IDs and legacy fields as compatibility projection only. One shared presence/lifetime resolver for every consumer.

end_statuses.known: Dated end with eventKind, date precision and evidence
end_statuses.occurred_date_unknown: Positive evidence an ending occurred, but date unknown
end_statuses.untraced: No established ending; neither ongoing existence nor extinction implied
end_statuses.not_applicable: Only when justified by entity/episode type

known_end_shape.eventKind: dissolved or operations_ceased or legal_amalgamation etc.

date.value: source date at its true precision
date.notBefore: only when source supplies a lower bound
date.before: only when source supplies an upper bound

presence_policy: A record is searchable irrespective of whether snapshot presence is known.
Untraced historical ends do not get infinite solid lifetime bars or current existence by default.
Show source-supported observation points or intervals; a last observation is not a dissolution.
An observation earlier in a year is not by itself proof of standing on December 31.
Operational and legal views use different bounds while preserving both claims.
Current confirmation is evidence at a date, not an unlimited future interval.

relations.accountability: Use explicit evidenced responsibility/electoral/constitutional routes; do not infer from structural placement.

do_not_infer: corporate operation solely from shared trustees
